findings.passage: Those moments can come at a homeowner very quickly. Fumbling around for a lockbox key or anything else, I find this bill cumbersome in the face of defending one's self at home to a deadly threat.
findings.note: Quoted by a TV news story from a Senate hearing on a safe gun storage bill; he objects that locking up guns would slow a homeowner defending against a break-in.

findings.passage: Many farmers have a readily available gun just for those emergencies. Fumbling around with a lock while a cow or a bull or any other animal is going after your daughter or your son, you can't fumble around with a key or try and find the lockbox or put your thumb on a biometric key of some sort in your home, while the danger is outside.
findings.note: Quoted by a TV news story from the same hearing; he argues the storage requirement would put farmers at risk when a farm animal attacks.

findings.passage: There are elements in this bill that are good. But confiscation of guns is not the solution, especially when criminals don't follow the law. And that provision will only be targeted on law abiding citizens.
findings.note: Quoted by a TV news story on Senate floor debate over HF 2609 (straw-purchase penalties plus a binary trigger ban); he says parts are good but objects to the trigger ban provision as confiscation.
